verdict.notes: Static source/contract audit. No fixture execution or runtime/deployment proof. Missing keyed discussion is completeness, separate from false factual assertions. Built-in Node API behavior is inferred; runtime version and actual host/proxy/renderer remain unknown. Full conditional paragraphs were retained as qualified. Source-authority false for reports lacking external provenance, or R07 conflating retrieval and recheck dates.
unsupported_gap_claims: - It has no read timeout, so slow clients can hold connections open. — No explicit timeout setting is visible, but absence of effective Node defaults is not established by supplied runtime evidence.
false_assurance_claims: - `..`, absolute entry names and an empty relative path are rejected before any write. — Blanket rejection of absolute entry names is too broad: an absolute destination already inside the workspace resolves to an allowed suffix. The actual guard rejects escapes.

- There are only three small test files. None cover the auth failure path, the traversal rejection (for example `../x` and `a/../../x`), or the render route. — Tests explicitly include missing/wrong credential rejection and role checks. The broad statement of no authentication/failure coverage is false, although HTTP end-to-end tests are absent.
